findings.evidence: TalentAdvancedWindow.as: icon width/height=50 line43; x=237 line45, y=101 line46. Installed image/talent/talent/1105.png is46x46. findings.issue: The longest condition text fills all200 pixels before Flash text gutters
findings.evidence: TalentAdvancedWindowCE.as sets l_condition.x=284 and height24; TalentAdvancedWindow.as overrides its width to200 at line40. Installed ModuleFont.swf hkhb font advances measured for all plantTalentInfo.txt condName rows: max200px at font16,189px at font15,175px at font14. Talent1105 is one of the200px conditions.
findings.geometry: The field ends at x484, so it is inside the504 popup. The clipping arises from text width/gutters rather than an offscreen field.
findings.minimal_fix: Set this popup's l_condition fontSize to15, leaving11 pixels beyond the longest advance. Keep x284,width200,height24 and the existing condition text, link, tooltip, and color logic.
findings.validation_limit: Font advance measurements from FFDec TTF via Pillow are independent source evidence and exclude Flash TextField gutters/shadow; real Flash rendering remains the final visual check.
